knowledge:
- key_parameters: target=The target transcription factor (typically the one with experimental ChIP-seq evidence), specified as an Entrez Gene ID ;; query=A vector of query transcription factors (with enriched motifs in the target's neighborhood), specified as Entrez Gene IDs ;; method=The algorithm used to find the TRM (e.g., "nsa") ;; max.bridge=The maximum number of bridge proteins allowed between the target and query nodes (default is 0, meaning directly connected; set to 1 to allow one intermediate node) ;; organism=Species for ortholog mapping (e.g., "mouse", "human") ;; type=Output graph format in findTRM (default returns an igraph object, but can be set to "graphNEL")
- alternatives: HOMER or TOMTOM can be used externally for motif enrichment, whereas PWMEnrich and MotifDb can be used for an all-R workflow. PSICQUIC can be used to retrieve PPI data from external databases (like BioGRID, STRING, KEGG, or Reactome) instead of using the built-in biogrid_mm or getBiogridData() functions.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have ChIP-seq data for a target transcription factor, a list of enriched motifs/TFs, and paired gene expression data, and you want to identify physical/functional transcriptional regulatory modules (cooperating TFs) using a protein-protein interaction network.
- pitfalls: PWMEnrich will throw an error if the input sequences are shorter than the motifs; sequences must be filtered using a minimum width check (width(seq) >= max(sapply(p, ncol))). PPI networks often contain highly connected hub proteins (e.g., Ubc, Sumo1, Sumo2, Sumo3) that act as artificial bridges; these outliers should be removed using removeVertices() to avoid false-positive TRM connections. Ensure the filtered PPI network is reduced to its largest connected component using getLargestComp() to avoid disconnected graph errors during layout generation.

workflows.name: trm_from_precomputed_motifs
workflows.intent: Identify a transcriptional regulatory module (TRM) around a target TF using pre-computed motif enrichment results, gene expression data, and a filtered PPI network.
input: sox2_motif_list.rda (list of enriched motifs from TOMTOM/HOMER)
ESC-expressed.txt (text file of expressed genes in the cell type)
workflows.stages: 1. Map enriched motifs to Entrez Gene IDs using getOrthologFromMatrix ;; 2. Filter the TF list to keep only expressed TFs ;; 3. Load the PPI network and remove high-degree hub outliers using removeVertices ;; 4. Filter the PPI network to keep only expressed proteins using induced.subgraph ;; 5. Extract the largest connected component of the PPI network using getLargestComp ;; 6. Define the target TF and find the TRM using findTRM ;; 7. Generate a concentric layout using getConcentricList and layout.concentric ;; 8. Plot the TRM and its legend using plotTRM and plotTRMlegend
workflows.code:
motif_file <- system.file("extra/sox2_motif_list.rda", package = "rTRM")
load(motif_file)
tfs_list <- getOrthologFromMatrix(motif_list, organism = "mouse")
tfs_list <- unique(unlist(tfs_list, use.names = FALSE))
eg_esc_file <- system.file("extra/ESC-expressed.txt", package = "rTRM")
eg_esc <- scan(eg_esc_file, what = "")
tfs_list_esc <- tfs_list[tfs_list %in% eg_esc]
data(biogrid_mm)
ppi <- biogrid_mm
f <- c("Ubc", "Sumo1", "Sumo2", "Sumo3")
f <- select(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = f, columns = "ENTREZID", keytype = "SYMBOL")$ENTREZID
ppi <- removeVertices(ppi, f)
ppi_esc <- induced.subgraph(ppi, V(ppi)[ name %in% eg_esc ])
ppi_esc <- getLargestComp(ppi_esc)
target <- select(org.Mm.eg.db,keys="Sox2",columns="ENTREZID",keytype="SYMBOL")$ENTREZID
s <- findTRM(ppi_esc, target, tfs_list_esc, method = "nsa", max.bridge = 1)
cl <- getConcentricList(s, target, tfs_list_esc)
l <- layout.concentric(s, cl, order = "label")
plotTRM(s, layout = l, vertex.cex = 15, label.cex = .8)
plotTRMlegend(s, title = "ESC Sox2 TRM", cex = .8)

workflows.name: all_r_pwmenrich_workflow
workflows.intent: Perform the entire TRM identification workflow completely within R, starting from genomic peak coordinates (BED file) and using PWMEnrich for motif enrichment.
input: ESC_Sox2_peaks.txt (BED file of ChIP-seq peak coordinates)
ESC-expressed.txt (text file of expressed genes in the cell type)
workflows.stages: 1. Retrieve mouse PWMs from MotifDb and convert them to integer counts ;; 2. Generate a background model using makeBackground ;; 3. Read peak coordinates and extract genomic sequences using getSequencesFromGenome ;; 4. Filter out sequences shorter than the maximum motif width ;; 5. Compute motif enrichment using motifEnrichment and identify enriched genes using groupReport ;; 6. Filter the PPI network by expression and remove hub outliers ;; 7. Find the TRM using findTRM and visualize it using layout.concentric or layout.arc
workflows.code:
library(rTRM)
library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm8.masked)
library(PWMEnrich)
registerCoresPWMEnrich(1)
library(MotifDb)
sel.mm <- values(MotifDb)$organism %in% c("Mmusculus")
pwm.mm <- MotifDb[sel.mm]
p <- as.list(pwm.mm)
p <- lapply(p, function(x) round(x * 100))
p <- lapply(p, function(x) t(apply(x, 1, as.integer)))
pwm_logn <- makeBackground(p, Mmusculus, type = "logn")
sox2_bed <- read.table(system.file("extra/ESC_Sox2_peaks.txt", package = "rTRM"))
colnames(sox2_bed) <- c("chr", "start", "end")
sox2_seq <- getSequencesFromGenome(sox2_bed, Mmusculus, append.id="Sox2")
min.width <- max(sapply(p, ncol))
sox2_seq_filter <- sox2_seq[width(sox2_seq) >= min.width]
sox2_enr <- motifEnrichment(sox2_seq_filter, pwms=pwm_logn, group.only=TRUE)
res <- groupReport(sox2_enr)
res.gene <- unique(values(MotifDb[res$id[res$raw.score > 5]])$geneId)
res.gene <- unique(na.omit(res.gene))
data(biogrid_mm)
ppi <- biogrid_mm
f <- c("Ubc", "Sumo1", "Sumo2", "Sumo3")
f <- select(org.Mm.eg.db,keys=f,columns="ENTREZID",keytype="SYMBOL")$ENTREZID
ppi <- removeVertices(ppi, f)
eg_esc <- scan(system.file("extra/ESC-expressed.txt", package = "rTRM"), what = "")
ppi_esc <- induced.subgraph(ppi, V(ppi)[ name %in% eg_esc ])
ppi_esc <- getLargestComp(ppi_esc)
sox2.gene <- select(org.Mm.eg.db,keys="Sox2",columns="ENTREZID",keytype="SYMBOL")$ENTREZID
sox2_trm <- findTRM(ppi_esc, target=sox2.gene, query = res.gene)
cl <- getConcentricList(sox2_trm, t=sox2.gene,e=res.gene)
l <- layout.concentric(sox2_trm, concentric=cl, order="label")
plotTRM(sox2_trm, layout = l, vertex.cex = 15, label.cex = .8)
plotTRMlegend(sox2_trm, title = "ESC Sox2 TRM", cex = .8)
l=layout.arc(sox2_trm,target=sox2.gene,query=res.gene)
plotTRM(sox2_trm, layout=l,vertex.cex=15,label.cex=.7)
